## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): e-side n = +3.2×10¹², h-side n = −1.2×10¹²

Why: a feasibility check (oscillation onset, tone content, sensitivity) before committing hours to a Landau fan. Both cuts are on the region-A D = 0 line (run-5 calibration). Run 6 ramps B 0 → 10 T; run 7 rides it back down 10 → 0.3 T. Both use sr1 at 50 µV.

# Runs 6-7 — sdh-spot-check at D = 0 (run-5 cal): raw R(B) first, then background-subtracted trace + FFT + tone onsets.
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 7.5))
for j, (rid, n12) in enumerate(((6, 3.2), (7, -1.2))):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / (r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain))
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(np.array([abs(n12) * 1e16]))[0])
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12 (run-5 cal, F_L = {FL:.1f} T); R {R.min():.0f}-{R.max():.0f} Ohm, "
          f"R(10 T) {np.median(R[B > 9.9]):.0f} Ohm; T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K; "
          f"|I_gate| max {max(np.abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')).max(), np.abs(r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')).max())*1e12:.0f} pA")
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.8); ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("|Rxx| B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid} raw — n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    print(sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9).summary())
    f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(1.5, 10.0), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5)
    m = (f > 1) & (f < 3 * FL)
    ax[1, j].plot(f[m], sp[0][m] / sp[0][m].max())
    for x, l in ((FL, "F_L"), (FL / 3, "F_L/3")):
        ax[1, j].axvline(x, color="k", ls=":", lw=0.8); ax[1, j].text(x, 1.0, l, fontsize=8)
    ax[1, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("|FFT| log R, 1.5-10 T (norm)"); ax[1, j].set_title(f"run {rid} SdH FFT")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read (runs 6–7):**
- **Oscillations are strong on both sides**, and the fan is feasible.
- **Run 6 (e-side):** Rxx reaches QH zeros (quantization floor) from ~2.5 T and exceeds 500 Ω between plateaus. The dominant tones are 7.1, 22.2 and 29.5 T; the light 7.1 T tone persists to the 0.3 T record edge, and the 22.2 T tone has its onset at ~1.3 T.
- **Two readings of run 6 fit:**
  - An ABAB-like pair, F_light + F_heavy = 7.1 + 22.2 ≈ 29.3 T, with ratio 0.32, plus a sum tone. In this reading F_L(model) = 33.1 T means the geometry-prior n scale is ~10 % high.
  - A single band at ≈ 29.5 T with a 7.1 T harmonic ladder. The ladder is off by ~4 % (21.3 / 28.4 expected), near the resolution dF ≈ 1.5–2.4 T.
- **Run 7 (h-side):** the strongest tone is 12.3 T (= F_L 12.4 T), with 6.6 and 4.7 T (onsets 0.7–1.0 T).
- **One density can't split these readings, nor rule out region-B tones** (region B is ≈ 0.43×10¹² more electron-doped). **Not a stacking read yet.**
- **The decisive observable is F(n) across density plus the fan-line families**, i.e. a D = 0 Landau fan (plan step 4).
- Timing calibration for the fan: each field point costs its ramp (0.137 T/min) + 3.1 s.

## HERA — Step 4: D = 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan`), n_A −1.25 → +3.23×10¹², B 0 → 10 T

> **05:26** · landau-fan D=0: n\_A -1.25..+3.23e12 (151 pts, co-swept Vtg/Vbg) x B 0->10 T (145 rows: 0 T, 1/B-uniform 0.7-3.6 T, 0.15 T to 10 T), fast 0.8 s, sr1 100 uV, ends 10 T gates 0 · **ETA ~13:11** (≈7h45m)

**Plan step 4** (`hera_scratch/plan.md`), requested by the operator as the stacking measurement.
- **Why this measurement:** runs 6–7 show strong SdH/QH on both sides, but a single density cannot tell apart the readings in play:
  - an ABAB-like pair (7.1 + 22.2 ≈ 29.5 T at n = +3.2×10¹²);
  - a single band with a harmonic ladder;
  - region-B tones (region B is ≈ 0.43×10¹² more electron-doped than A).
- **What decides it:** F(n) across density plus the fan-line families.
  - ABAB: two branches with F₁ + F₂ = F_L, ratio ≈ 0.2–0.3, and crossings between the two families.
  - ABCA: one branch at F ≈ F_L and no crossings at D = 0.
  - Region B: shows up as a second fan whose lines converge at n_A ≈ −0.43.
- The fan also fixes the absolute n scale from the QH minima (n = ν·eB/h). The run-5 scale is still the geometry prior.

**Geometry:**
- **Fast axis:** co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) along the region-A D = 0 line (run-5 cal). 151 pts at δn = 0.030×10¹², covering the full in-validator window (5 mV margin).
  - The hole side stops at −1.25×10¹² because of the TG −0.3 V limit. That limit is the operating box; extending it is banned.
  - Direction: hole → electron.
- **Slow axis:** B, ascending from where the magnet sits (0 T). ~146 rows:
  - one row at 0 T (the MR/background reference, aligned to the fan columns);
  - uniform in 1/B from 0.7 to 3.6 T, δ(1/B) = 0.0115 T⁻¹. Nyquist is 43 T, above F_L max ≈ 39 T including region B, and dF ≈ 0.8 T;
  - uniform 0.15 T from 3.6 to 10 T, for the QH fan and crossings.
  - Below 0.7 T only the light tone lives. Uniform-1/B rows there cost ~2.5 h for 0.5–0.7 T alone, so they're excluded.
- **Readout settings:**
  - `fast_delay` 0.8 s at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB. This is a constant ~1-pt lag in the fixed sweep direction, which folds into n_offset. Attenuation is ≲ 30 % at 1 T.
  - `slow_delay` 5 s after each flyback.
  - sr1 at **100 µV = 10 kΩ FS** (0.37 Ω quantization). Trade: a gapped ν = 0 CNP at high B may rail on a few columns; the stacking read doesn't use its magnitude.
- **Ends at 10 T with gates parked at 0 V.** Step 5 (finite-D fan) rides the magnet down from there.

**Price:** calibrated on run 5 (1.10 s/pt at 1.0 s delay, i.e. 0.10 s read overhead + ~0.03 s for the second gate) and run 6 (3.1 s per field set beyond the ramp).
- Per row: 151 × 0.93 s + 5 s slow_delay + ~6 s flyback + 3.1 s ≈ 155 s.
- Total: 146 rows ≈ 6.3 h + the 10 T ramp floor of 73 min ≈ 7.5 h. **Headline 7 h 45 m.**

**Guards:**
- Auto-abort if |I_gate| > 1 nA or T_sample > 2.0 K.
- Preconditions printed and asserted: T, B, V_si, heaters, nplci, drive, and τ (the pricing assumes τ).

**Checkpoints:**
1. **First rows (0 T and 0.7 T):** R(n) matches run 5's D = 0 cut (≈ 50–500 Ω, CNP near n_A = 0, ridge B near −0.43), no rail, gate currents at the pA floor. Abort on any failure.
2. **B ≈ 2 T (~2 h 20 m in):** partial fan. Fan lines visible and converging? Light tone in the per-column FFT?
3. **B = 3.6 T (end of the 1/B block, ~4 h 15 m in):** per-column F(n) on 0.7–3.6 T. This is the main discriminator.
   - If F(n) is already unambiguous, continuing to 10 T buys the n calibration and the QH crossings (~3.5 h).
   - If F(n) is washed out, abandon the top and re-plan.

# === Step 4 — D = 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan`): n_A -1.25 -> +3.23e12 along region-A D = 0, B 0 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.23, 151)            # 1e12 cm^-2, fast (co-swept gates), hole -> electron
D_fan = 0.0                                      # V/nm
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.full_like(n_vec, D_fan), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
print(f"fast: {len(n_vec)} pts, n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 (dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.4f}), D = {D_fan}; "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V")

# --- slow axis: 0 T row, uniform 1/B 0.7 -> 3.6 T (d(1/B) = 0.0115), uniform 0.15 T 3.74 -> 10 T ---
B_lo = 1.0 / np.arange(1 / 0.7, 1 / 3.6, -0.0115)
B_hi = np.linspace(3.74, 10.0, 43)
B_vec = np.round(np.hstack(([0.0], B_lo, B_hi)), 4)
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() >= 0
print(f"slow: {len(B_vec)} rows, B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_lo)} uniform-1/B rows 0.7-{B_lo[-1]:.3f} T, {len(B_hi)} rows at {B_hi[1]-B_hi[0]:.3f} T)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
_pre = dict(T=_T0, B=_B0, Vsi=k_si(), nplci=(k_tg.nplci(), k_bg.nplci()),
            heaters=(heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()),
            PS=magnet.persistent_switch_on(), out=magnet.output_enabled(),
            amp=sr1.amplitude(), f=sr1.frequency(), tau=(sr0.time_constant(), sr1.time_constant()),
            slope=(sr0.filter_slope(), sr1.filter_slope()), Tvap=T_vaporizer())
print("precondition (expect): T 1.0-1.5 K | |B| < 0.05 T | Vsi 0 | nplci 1/1 | heaters 0/0 | PS/out on | "
      "sr1 1.0 V @ 13.777 Hz | tau 0.3/0.3 s | slope 24/24")
print("precondition (actual):", _pre)
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} K off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not at 0 T: {_B0}"
assert abs(_pre["Vsi"]) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert _pre["nplci"] == (1.0, 1.0), "gate nplci not 1"
assert _pre["heaters"] == (0, 0), "heater range not off"
assert _pre["PS"] and _pre["out"], "magnet PS heater / output off"
assert abs(_pre["amp"] - 1.0) < 1e-6 and abs(_pre["f"] - 13.777) < 0.01, "drive changed"
assert _pre["tau"] == (0.3, 0.3) and _pre["slope"] == (24, 24), "lock-in tau/slope differ from the priced 0.3 s / 24 dB"

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 0.8, 5.0
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 2.0
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA (state0 left sr1 at 2 uV).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D = 0: n_A {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)}) along region-A D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"B 0 -> 10 T ({len(B_vec)} rows: 0 T, uniform 1/B 0.7-3.6 T, 0.15 T to 10 T), sr1 100 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan; fast: (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept, n_A {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, {len(n_vec)} pts, D = 0 V/nm; '
              f'slow: B {len(B_vec)} rows (0 T; 1/B-uniform 0.7-3.6 T d(1/B) 0.0115; 3.74-10 T at 0.149 T); '
              f'cal run 5: c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e}, c_bg {CAL["c_bg"]:.3e}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, tau 0.3 s/24 dB, sr1 100 uV')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, T_now = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), float(data[4])
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP or T_now > T_TRIP:
        print(f"GUARD TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A, T_sample={T_now:.3f} K")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    # field stays where the fan ended (10 T on completion) — step 5 rides it down; never re-traverse.
    print(f"done/park: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, Vtg = {k_tg.volt():+.4f}, Vbg = {k_bg.volt():+.4f}, Vsi = {k_si():+.3f} V, T = {T_sample():.3f} K")

from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
